Saudi Arabia Shelves NEOM Stadium Project Amidst FIFA World Cup Plans

Saudi Arabia has reportedly shelved plans for a $2.5 billion stadium in its NEOM project. This development comes despite the stadium being intended as part of the country's bid for the 2034 FIFA World Cup. The project's shelving raises questions about the future of the ambitious NEOM development.
